description: This file defines the SessionManager class responsible for managing media playback sessions. It handles queues, playback commands (play, pause, stop, seek), session lifecycle, and interacts with a Player interface to control media playback. The class also manages playlist items and notifies callbacks about state changes.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: Manages a media session queue, handles playback control, session lifecycle, playlist management, and communicates with a Player implementation and UI callbacks.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a media session is currently valid.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID if valid; otherwise null.

methods.name: getCurrentItem
methods.description: Retrieves the current media item being played.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns cached statistics about playback from the Player.

methods.name: getPlaylist
methods.description: Returns the current playlist.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the playback status and playlist info.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a media item to the playlist and optionally enqueues it.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the playlist by item ID.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within a playlist item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific playlist item.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and clears the playlist.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new media session.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Ends the current media session.

methods.name: getSessionStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the current session.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends playback, saving current state for later resumption.

methods.name: unsuspend
methods.description: Resumes playback after suspension, re-establishing queue if supported.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles playback error callback from Player.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Handles playback completion callback from Player.

methods.name: onPlaylistChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the playlist.

methods.name: onPlaylistReady
methods.description: Notifies that the playlist is ready and triggers UI update.

methods.name: setPlayer
methods.description: Sets the Player implementation for controlling media playback.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback interface for UI updates.
